items.title: Extend scope contract with semantic file rules
items.context: Add backward-compatible v2 fields for fileRules, allowedAnchors, deniedAnchors, protectedAnchors, allowedChangeKinds, and hunk-level acknowledgements without breaking B-be27 contracts.
items.userSees: scope_contract_show prints "fileRules:", "protectedAnchors:", and existing v1 fields; scope_contract_check still prints "Scope gate: pass" for an old B-be27-style contract.

happy.desc: A v2 contract with fileRules round-trips through set/show/check without losing v1 fields.

edge.desc: An old B-be27-style contract still checks successfully without semantic fields.

adversarial.desc: Invalid anchors, unsafe paths, or malformed hunk acknowledgements are rejected before persistence.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts a v2 scope contract with fileRules/allowedAnchors round-trips through set/show/check and still surfaces v1 fields; printed semantic scope guard smoke passed.
Legacy v1 (B-be27-style) scope-contract smoke still passes -> path-only contracts without semantic fields check successfully, backward compatible.
Smoke asserts invalid anchors, unsafe paths and malformed hunk acknowledgements are rejected before persistence (set() throws / check fails).

items.title: Generate mechanical diff context packs
items.context: Add scope_diff_pack that reports changed files, hunks, digest, nearest symbols where possible, package/json key changes, metadata skips, and diffPackHash for reviewer consumption.
items.userSees: scope_diff_pack --json prints "diffPackHash", changed "anchor" names, package/json "keyPath" changes, and "parseFallback" when a file cannot be symbol-parsed.

happy.desc: Diff pack identifies TS function/export anchors for changed hunks.

edge.desc: Unparseable or non-code files fall back to file/hunk level without passing silently.

adversarial.desc: Package script or CLI schema changes are surfaced as key-level changes in the pack.

verificationEvidence.note: scope_diff_pack --json identified TS anchors (COMMAND_POLICIES, capsuleEvidenceRefSchema, clusterHandlers) for changed hunks and emitted diffPackHash dbd61eae57941539cee821e3a269c8769a161de2.
Non-code/unparseable files fall back explicitly: scope_diff_pack reported parseFallback unsupported_file_type and no_nearest_ts_anchor rather than passing silently; smoke asserts the fallback path.
Package/CLI schema changes surfaced as key-level changes: pack reported keyPath test:scope-contract-smoke (package.json script add) plus userSees/phase keyPaths.

items.title: Enforce semantic hunk gate in lifecycle checks
items.context: Use scope contract v2 plus diff pack to fail allowed-file changes that touch denied/protected anchors or unacknowledged out-of-intent hunks. Keep v1 contracts path-only.
items.userSees: story_advance REVIEW/TEST/DONE prints "Semantic scope gate: pass" or "Semantic scope gate: fail" with violating "path", "anchor", and "hunkDigest".

happy.desc: Allowed file plus allowed anchor passes semantic gate.

edge.desc: V1 contracts continue using path gate only.

adversarial.desc: Allowed file touching denied or protected anchor fails even when file path is allowed.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts an allowed file touching an allowed anchor passes the semantic scope gate (Semantic scope gate: pass).
Legacy v1 contract smoke confirms v1 contracts continue using path gate only with no semantic hunk enforcement.
Smoke asserts an allowed file touching a denied/protected anchor FAILS the semantic gate (reporting violating path/anchor/hunkDigest) even though the file path itself is allowed.

items.title: Add Koala-managed guarded session status
items.context: Add guard_session_start/status/check support for Koala-dispatched agents. This extends existing session ownership/write-lease data with a scope-guard projection; it must not replace owner lease or create a competing session truth source. Implement watcher-fallback semantics and process events; do not promise universal OS/editor blocking.
items.userSees: session_brief prints "guard session: active", "guard session: watcher-fallback", "guard session: inactive", or "guard session: violations detected" under the story scope protection block.

happy.desc: guard_session_start records provider, guardMode, scopeContractHash, and active status.

edge.desc: Unsupported provider is represented as watcher-fallback instead of pretending pre-tool blocking exists.

adversarial.desc: A simulated forbidden write is recorded as a guard violation and blocks lifecycle progression.

items.title: Bind reviewer evidence to scope and diff hashes
items.context: After CHK-001~003 establish stable scopeContractHash, diffPackHash, and semantic hunk digests, bind review passes for scope-protected stories to those hashes plus reviewedChangedFiles, reviewedIntentRefs, and reviewedHunkDigests. Old stories and stories without scope protection stay backward compatible.
items.userSees: REVIEW→TEST gate rejects review passes missing the current scopeContractHash, diffPackHash, or reviewed hunk digest binding, and reports exactly which reviewer evidence is stale or incomplete.

happy.desc: Fresh review evidence with matching scopeContractHash and diffPackHash passes REVIEW→TEST.

edge.desc: Stories without scope contract stay backward compatible unless scope protection is enabled.

adversarial.desc: Missing or stale diffPackHash/reviewedHunkDigests blocks REVIEW→TEST.

items.title: Productize status output, initialization, and regression tests
items.context: Productize the integrated view after CHK-001~005: enhance session_brief with an aggregate Scope protection summary, add scope_contract_init_from_plan, and add end-to-end smoke/regression tests. CHK-004 owns guard-session data; CHK-006 owns the combined summary and full-chain bypass regression.
items.userSees: session_brief prints "Scope protection summary" with "path gate", "semantic gate", "guard mode", "review hash freshness", and "next action" rows.

happy.desc: scope_contract_init_from_plan creates a usable contract from checklist files and intents.

edge.desc: session_brief gracefully reports no scope protection for old stories.

adversarial.desc: Regression test fails if semantic gate or review hash binding can be bypassed by natural-language-only evidence.
